translations.web: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
translations.bsb: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.
translations.kjv: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
translations.asv: The stones thereof are the place of sapphires, And it hath dust of gold.
